comments.content: I'm not sure I understand your question. Can you elaborate?

Mailer has two constructor, one take Session as parameter and the other has 4
parameters, which Mailer use createMailSession() to create defaultSession, but this
session does not support proxy, user have to create a customed Session to support
proxy, so why not provide a method to handle this?
Ahh, good question, I'll look into it.

I skimmed through the documentation and was rather intimidated by the added 
complexity. Since I'm working at various projects in my spare time only, I can't spend 
a lot of time on proxy support. I've decided not to support it.

If you have the time for it though: patches are welcome ofcourse!
